summary: Five pooled BALB/c male lung samples (vehicle, fly ash PM 1/10 mg/kg/day, standard PM2.5 1/10 mg/kg/day) x 3 injections on Orbitrap Exploris 480; all claims match PRIDE and the paper. Only minor findings.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent; producer transcript, report.md and prior reviews not read; evidence read only from scratchpad/bkk/<PXD>/ plus independent PRIDE FTP/OLS/Cellosaurus fetches

spec_compliance.evidence: 37 columns, 15 rows, ms-proteomics + vertebrates v1.1.0 declared and validated; assay names unique; factor columns last; NCE and scan-range formats valid.

ontology_integrity.evidence: sdrf-tools check: 8/8 terms verified, CLEAN (MS:1003028, MS:1001251, MS:1001309, MS:1000422, PRIDE:0000627). Warnings only for free-text treatment and BALB/c strain.

source_evidence.evidence: Paper (doi 10.1016/j.toxrep.2025.102110) Methods: 'Eight to twelve-week-old male Balb/c mice', five groups n=6 (saline; fly ash 1 and 10; standard PM2.5 1 and 10 mg/kg/day), intratracheal once daily 7 days; lung tissues 'collected, pooled'; EasyPep with trypsin/Lys-C; triplicate injections; Exploris 480, MS1 525-1200 m/z, HCD 27%.

file_mapping.evidence: 15 RAW files in files.json, all mapped once; Lung_PM25.msf (SEARCH) excluded.

design_consistency.evidence: 5 pooled sources x technical replicates 1-3 (N1-N3); dose and treatment factors reproduce the 5 groups; biological replicate 1 per pool is correct.

omission_safety.evidence: Search tolerances/modifications and reduction/alkylation reagents left 'not available' (not stated; msf 4.3 GB not inspected); no value asserts more than the sources.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf with the file's declared templates: exit 0, warnings only ('Most seems to be fine. There were only warnings.'); sdrf-tools check and score run; check CLEAN; score 100/100.
